original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-extensions-of-relative-ringed-topoi}
Let $f : (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}) \to
(\Sh(\mathcal{B}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{B})$ be a morphism of
ringed topoi. Let $\mathcal{G}$ be an $\mathcal{O}$-module.
The set of isomorphism classes of extensions of
$f^{-1}\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{B}$-algebras
$$
0 \to \mathcal{G} \to \mathcal{O}' \to \mathcal{O} \to 0
$$
where $\mathcal{G}$ is an ideal of square zero\footnote{In other words,
the set of isomorphism classes of first order thickenings
$i : (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}) \to (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}')$
over $(\Sh(\mathcal{B}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{B})$ endowed with an isomorphism
$\mathcal{G} \to \Ker(i^\sharp)$ of $\mathcal{O}$-modules.} 
is canonically bijective to
$\Ext^1_\mathcal{O}(\NL_{\mathcal{O}/\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{B}}, \mathcal{G})$.

stage_a_standalone_statement_draft:
A first-order thickening of ringed topoi is a morphism $i:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),\mathcal O)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D),\mathcal O')$ whose direct-image functor identifies the underlying topoi and whose structure-sheaf map $\mathcal O'\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal O$ is surjective with square-zero kernel $\mathcal I$. Under this identification $\mathcal I$ is an $\mathcal O$-module. A general thickening requires only a locally nilpotent kernel.

For a ringed topos morphism $f:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),\mathcal O)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal B),\mathcal O_{\mathcal B})$, the naive relative cotangent complex $\mathrm{NL}_{\mathcal O/f^{-1}\mathcal O_\mathcal B}$ is the two-term complex of $\mathcal O$-modules given by a locally free sheaf-algebra presentation of $f^{-1}\mathcal O_\mathcal B\to\mathcal O$, in degrees $-1,0$. Its extensions and obstruction classes are computed in $D(\mathcal O)$.

Let $f : (\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}) \to
(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{B}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{B})$ be a morphism of
ringed topoi. Let $\mathcal{G}$ be an $\mathcal{O}$-module.
The set of isomorphism classes of extensions of
$f^{-1}\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{B}$-algebras
$$
0 \to \mathcal{G} \to \mathcal{O}' \to \mathcal{O} \to 0
$$
where $\mathcal{G}$ is an ideal of square zero\footnote{In other words,
the set of isomorphism classes of first order thickenings
$i : (\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}) \to (\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}')$
over $(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{B}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{B})$ endowed with an isomorphism
$\mathcal{G} \to \Ker(i^\sharp)$ of $\mathcal{O}$-modules.} 
is canonically bijective to
$\operatorname{Ext}^1_\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{NL}_{\mathcal{O}/\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{B}}, \mathcal{G})$.
stage_b_review_note: Preserves square-zero extensions of f^{-1}O_B-algebras of ringed topoi, together with identified module G, in canonical bijection with Ext^1_O(NL_{O/O_B},G); the thickening footnote is retained.
